title: Moliboo Marketplace Genesis — 100 New 2D Character Concepts
disclaimer: These are Modula house concepts, not existing official originals or community creator listings. No real licences, copyright transfers, or marketplace approvals are created by this file.
original_legacy: Existing original characters 001–100 remain the Founding Originals. This file proposes concepts numbered 101–200 for a second collection.

design_rules.style: soft vector-friendly silhouettes; distinct eye, mouth, shape and accessory markers
design_rules.assets: Render and host assets on demand; do not hardcode full catalog into native app
